title: SCAR: Sparse Conditioned Autoencoders for Concept Detection and Steering in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the toxicity of model generations using toxicity scores from the Perspective API on the RealToxicityPrompts and ToxicChat datasets, and measuring the reduction of toxicity when steering the model's latent features.

Assessing the model's generation of hate speech by measuring toxicity and unsafeness scores (via Perspective API and Llama Guard) on the Ethos dataset, which is designed for online hate speech detection.
